comparably.definition: in a comparable manner or to a comparable degree; "you will have to work comparably harder"

comparatively.definition: in a relative manner; by comparison to something else; "the situation is relatively calm now"

compassionately.definition: in a compassionate manner; "the nurse looked at him pityingly"

competently.definition: with competence; in a competent capable manner; "they worked competently"

competitively.definition: in competition; "the companies should bid competitively"

complacently.definition: in a self-satisfied manner; "he complacently lived out his life as a village school teacher"

complainingly.definition: with complaints; "she did her work, but she did so complainingly"

completely.definition: to a complete degree or to the full or entire extent (`whole' is often used informally for `wholly'); "he was wholly convinced"; "entirely satisfied with the meal"; "it was completely different from what we expected"; "was completely at fault"; "a totally new situation"; "the directions were all wrong"; "it was not altogether her fault"; "an altogether new approach"; "a whole new idea"; "she felt right at home"; "he fell right into the trap"

composedly.definition: in a self-collected or self-possessed manner; "he announced the death of his father collectedly"

compulsively.definition: in a compulsive manner; "he cleaned his shoes compulsively after every walk"

compulsorily.definition: in a manner that cannot be evaded; "the ministry considers that contributions to such a fund should be met from voluntary donations rather than from rates compulsorily levied."

computationally.definition: with regard to computation; "computationally, this is a tricky problem"

conceitedly.definition: with conceit; in a conceited manner; "he always acts so conceitedly!"

conceivably.definition: within the realm of possibility; "the weather may conceivably change"

conceptually.definition: in a conceptual manner; "he can no longer think conceptually"; "conceptually, the idea is quite simple"

concernedly.definition: in a manner showing concern; "`Are you all right,' he asked concernedly"

concisely.definition: in a concise manner; in a few words; "the history is summed up concisely in this book"; "she replied briefly"; "briefly, we have a problem"; "to put it shortly"

conclusively.definition: in a conclusive way; "we settled the problem conclusively"

concretely.definition: in concrete terms; "concretely, this meant that he was broke"

concurrently.definition: overlapping in duration; "concurrently with the conference an exhibition of things associated with Rutherford was held"; "going to school and holding a job at the same time"

condescendingly.definition: with condescension; in a patronizing manner; "he treats his secretary condescendingly"

conditionally.definition: subject to a condition; "he accepted the offer conditionally"

confessedly.definition: as acknowledged; "true, she is the smartest in her class"

confidentially.definition: in a confidential manner; "spoke to him intimately and confidentially"

confidently.definition: with confidence; in a confident manner; "we have to do what is right confidently"

confidingly.definition: with trust; in a trusting manner; "she looked at her father trustingly"

confoundedly.definition: in a perplexed manner; "he looked at his professor perplexedly"

confusedly.definition: in a confused manner; "Queen Augusta wrote him an hysterical letter in which she confusedly sympathised with him"

confusingly.definition: in a bewildering and confusing manner; "her situation was bewilderingly unclear"

congenially.definition: in a congenial manner; "`Let's all have a drink together,' he said congenially"

conjecturally.definition: in a manner involving or inclined to conjecture and supposition

conjointly.definition: in conjunction with; combined; "our salaries put together couldn't pay for the damage"; "we couldn't pay for the damages with all our salaries put together"

conscientiously.definition: with extreme conscientiousness; "he came religiously every morning at 8 o'clock"

consciously.definition: with awareness; "she consciously played with the idea of inviting them"

consecutively.definition: in a consecutive manner; "he was consecutively ill, then well, then ill again"

consequently.definition: (sentence connectors) because of the reason given; "consequently, he didn't do it"; "continued to have severe headaches and accordingly returned to the doctor"

conservatively.definition: in a conservative manner; "we estimated the number of demonstrators conservatively at 200,000."

considerably.definition: to a great extent or degree; "I'm afraid the film was well over budget"; "painting the room white made it seem considerably (or substantially) larger"; "the house has fallen considerably in value"; "the price went up substantially"

considerately.definition: in a considerate manner; "they considerately withdrew"

consistently.definition: in a systematic or consistent manner; "they systematically excluded women"

consolingly.definition: in a comforting or consoling manner; "one part of a strange world should be given a comfortingly familiar form"

conspicuously.definition: in a manner tending to attract attention; "there have been plenty of general declarations about willingness to meet and talk, but conspicuously no mention of time and place"

constantly.definition: without variation or change, in every case; "constantly kind and gracious"; "he always arrives on time"

constitutionally.definition: according to the constitution; "this was constitutionally ruled out"

constructively.definition: in a constructive manner; "it is my task to look critically and constructively at the flaws and the failures"

contagiously.definition: in a contagious manner; "she was contagiously bubbly"

contemporaneously.definition: during the same period of time; "contemporaneously, or possibly a little later, there developed a great Sumerian civilisation"

contemptuously.definition: without respect; in a disdainful manner; "she spoke of him contemptuously"

contentedly.definition: with equanimity; "`I bought it,' she said contentedly"

contextually.definition: in a manner dependent on context

continually.definition: seemingly without interruption; "complained continually that there wasn't enough money"

continuously.definition: at every point; "The function is continuously differentiable"

contractually.definition: by virtue of a contract; "they were contractually responsible"

contradictorily.definition: in a contradictory manner; "he argued contradictorily"

contrastingly.definition: in a contrasting manner; "contrastingly, both the rooms leading off it gave an immediate impression of being disgraced"

contritely.definition: in a rueful manner; "`I made a big mistake,' he said ruefully"

contumaciously.definition: in a rebellious manner; "he rejected her words rebelliously"

contumeliously.definition: without respect; in a disdainful manner; "she spoke of him contemptuously"

conveniently.definition: in a convenient manner; "the switch was conveniently located"

conventionally.definition: in a conventional manner; "he usually behaves rather conventionally"

conversationally.definition: with the use of colloquial expressions; "this building is colloquially referred to as The Barn"

conversely.definition: with the terms of the relation reversed; "conversely, not all women are mothers"

convexly.definition: in a convex way; "bulging out convexly"

convincingly.definition: in a convincing manner; "he argued convincingly"

convivially.definition: in a convivial manner; "`Let's go and have a drink,' she said convivially"

convulsively.definition: with convulsions, in a convulsive way; "her leg twitched convulsively"

coolly.definition: in a composed and unconcerned manner; "without more ado Barker borrowed a knife from his brigade Major and honed it on a carborundum stone as coolly as a butcher"

cooperatively.definition: in close cooperation; "they work hand in glove"

copiously.definition: in an abundant manner; "they were abundantly supplied with food"; "he thanked her profusely"

coquettishly.definition: in a flirtatious manner; "she smiled coquettishly"

cordially.definition: in a hearty manner; "`Yes,' the children chorused heartily"; "We welcomed her warmly"

correctly.definition: in an accurate manner; "the flower had been correctly depicted by his son"; "he guessed right"

correspondingly.definition: in a corresponding manner; "the temperature decreases correspondingly"

cortically.definition: with respect to the cortex; "cortically induced arousal"

cosily.definition: in a cozy manner; "nestled cozily by the fire"

cosmetically.definition: for cosmetic purposes to improve appearance; "it is used cosmetically by many women"

courageously.definition: in a courageous manner; "bravely he went into the burning house"

courteously.definition: in a polite manner; "the policeman answered politely, `Now look here, lady...'"

covertly.definition: in a covert manner; "he did it covertly"

covetously.definition: with jealousy; in an envious manner; "he looked at his friend's new car jealously"

coyly.definition: in a coy manner; "she pouted and looked at him coyly"

cozily.definition: in a cozy manner; "nestled cozily by the fire"

craftily.definition: in an artful manner; "he craftily arranged to be there when the decision was announced"; "had ever circumstances conspired so cunningly?"

crazily.definition: in an insane manner; "she behaved insanely"; "he behaves crazily when he is off his medication"; "the witch cackled madly"; "screaming dementedly"

creakily.definition: in a creaky manner; "the old boat was moving along creakily"

creakingly.definition: in a creaky manner; "the old boat was moving along creakily"

creatively.definition: in a creative manner; "she solved the problem creatively"

credibly.definition: easy to believe on the basis of available evidence; "he talked plausibly before the committee"; "he will probably win the election"

creditably.definition: to a tolerably worthy extent; "he did respectably well for his age"

credulously.definition: in a credulous manner; "the children followed the teacher credulously"

criminally.definition: in a shameful manner; "the garden was criminally neglected"

crisply.definition: in a well delineated manner; "the new style of Minoan pottery was sharply defined"

critically.definition: in a critical manner; "this must be examined critically"

crookedly.definition: in a crooked lopsided manner; "he smiled lopsidedly"

crossly.definition: in an ill-natured manner; "she looked at her husband crossly"

crossways.definition: transversely; "the marble slabs were cut across"

crucially.definition: to a crucial degree; "crucially important"; "crucially, he must meet us at the airport"

crudely.definition: in a crude or unrefined manner; "he was crudely bold"

crushingly.definition: in a crushing manner; "the team was crushingly defeated"

cryptically.definition: in a cryptic manner; "`we will meet again', he said cryptically"

culpably.definition: in a manner or to a degree deserving blame or censure

culturally.definition: with regard to a culture; "culturally integrated"

cumulatively.definition: in a cumulative manner; "mind has become self-reproducing through man's capacity to transmit experience and its products cumulatively"

cunningly.definition: in an attractive manner; "how cunningly the olive-green dress with its underskirt of rose-brocade fitted her perfect figure"

curiously.definition: in a manner differing from the usual or expected; "had a curiously husky voice"; "he's behaving rather peculiarly"

currently.definition: at this time or period; now; "he is presently our ambassador to the United Nations"; "currently they live in Connecticut"

currishly.definition: in a currish manner; meanspiritedly; "he behaved ignobly"

cursedly.definition: in a damnable manner; "kindly Arthur--so damnably, politely, endlessly persistent!"

cursorily.definition: without taking pains; "he looked cursorily through the magazine"

curtly.definition: in a curt, abrupt and discourteous manner; "he told me curtly to get on with it"; "he talked short with everyone"; "he said shortly that he didn't like it"

curvaceously.definition: in a curvaceous way; "his date was curvaceously beguiling"

cussedly.definition: in a stubborn unregenerate manner; "she remained stubbornly in the same position"

customarily.definition: by custom; according to common practice; "children are customarily expected to be seen but not heard"

cutely.definition: in an attractive manner; "how cunningly the olive-green dress with its underskirt of rose-brocade fitted her perfect figure"

cuttingly.definition: in an intentionally unkind way; "a cutting remark"

cynically.definition: with cynicism; in a cynical manner; "Larsen's frost-blackened lips curved cynically"
